verdict.rationale: Baseten's Model APIs let developers call hosted, supported language models without deploying them, through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, so shared serverless endpoints exist. The deprecation doc suggests the hosted model list changes over time. However, no evidence names any model family or shows how broad the catalog is. Missing for 10: a named list of hosted model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS), evidence of catalog breadth and currency, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among a broad catalog of current open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) on shared serverless endpoints

citations.quote: Use Model APIs to call supported language models without deploying them.
